summary: The flat 2D visuals are colourful and follow the domestic kitchen setting consistently. However, several shots suffer from awkward scaling, repeated assets, and minor logic mismatches in mate handling.

clean: Pouring action and cross-section diagrams illustrate yerba moisture concept clearly.
Grandmother and grandchild character designs remain consistent across scenes.
unclean: Shot 5: Character holding his head does not illustrate the dry yerba waiting its turn.
Shot 9: Both grandmother and grandchild hold separate mates during a mate-sharing scene.

clean: Vector styling, outlines, and palette match flat2d specifications.
Captions and diagram labels remain legible in the upper third.
unclean: Shot 8: Figures appear significantly underscaled behind an overly dominant counter.
Shot 12: Identical close-up asset of grandmother with heart eyes repeated from shot 10.

issues.problem: Figure pose does not reflect the yerba state mentioned in voiceover.
issues.fix: Show a diagrammatic mate top-view highlighting dry versus wet areas.

issues.problem: Characters appear tiny relative to the counter and kitchen background.
issues.fix: Zoom camera in or lower counter height to keep characters prominent.

issues.problem: Both characters hold their own mate simultaneously instead of passing one.
issues.fix: Remove the second mate gourd and show one being passed hand-to-hand.

issues.problem: Exact visual duplicate of grandma close-up from shot 10.
issues.fix: Vary framing, angle, or facial expression to avoid visual repetition.

learnings.rule: Avoid showing multiple mate gourds in sharing scenes where one shared mate is culturally appropriate.
Maintain consistent counter-to-character proportions across wide kitchen shots.
